papers.title_en: MetaRSI / RSI2: A Meta-Recursive Self-Improving System for Recursive Self-Improving Systems Themselves
papers.authors: Zihan Tan, Leixin Sun, Zitong Shi, Yitao Liu, Jiajun Wu, Nathaniel Brooks, Jiaru Qian, Xiaoran Shang, Suyuan Huang, Yi Ding, Yangxu Liao, Mukai Li, Qiushi Sun, Shudong Liu, Xuankun Rong, Xiaohang Yu, Zhuo Chen, Hejia Geng, Chenxin Li, Aozhou Wang, Zengji Tu, Robert Tang, Yuxin Zhan, Eric Jiang, Yuxin Wu, Jianqing Zhang, Xiao Liang, Fang Wu, Haochi Zhang, Alexander Marlow, Guancheng Wan
papers.evidence: 元递归自我改进的自主研究系统
papers.tldr: 递归自我改进（RSI）已能让系统从失败中改进建模机制，但此前几乎只在代码与形式化基准上验证，难以覆盖开放性科学问题。MetaRSI-v1 将改进拆为 Data-RSI、Harness-RSI、Model-RSI 三类算子，在统一循环内核与产物词汇下可组合调度，并由两轴优化器决定顺序与提案策略。系统在代码与闭式科学基准上、无外部教师、目标模型自扮所有角色完成验证。它把自改进从单面编辑扩展为覆盖模型生产全流程的组合，并给出模型与脚手架两条路径。
papers.abstract_en: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets a system improve the model-building machinery from its own failures, so every later model inherits the gain. Yet RSI has been validated almost exclusively on coding and formal benchmarks such as science QA and mathematics. This format bound limits RSI to improvement within a machine-checkable slice, not general capability where questions are open and correctness is settled by argument, replication, or measurement. We argue RSI must next operate across real, diverse scientific, engineering, and meta-scientific domains, not where formal evaluation is merely tractable. To that end we present MetaRSI-v1, where improvement is the scheduled composition of three typed operators over one unified paradigm. Data-RSI amplifies existing competence and marks its boundary; Harness-RSI edits a five-slot scaffold without touching weights; Model-RSI internalizes capability into parameters through bounded training. Sharing one loop kernel and artifact vocabulary, they make data, scaffold, and model changes composable rather than exclusive. A two-axis optimizer jointly decides operator order and each operator's proposal policy, while a meta-level policy revises the schedule across terms. We validate MetaRSI-v1 under the field's standard evaluations, on code and closed-form science, with no external teacher: the target model plays every role in its own loop. MetaRSI-v1 reframes self-improvement from a single-surface edit to a composition across the full model-production pipeline, opening two paths: a model route internalizing capability through training, and a harness route leaving weights untouched and thus extending self-improvement to any model reachable through an interface, with Data-RSI redefined as the shared substrate feeding both. The framework further yields refutable laws on where loops exist, how operators compose, and what supervision buys.

papers.title_en: AlphaRJM: Reward-Jump Memory for Stochastic Return-Guided Alpha Discovery
papers.evidence: 面向公式化Alpha发现的池依赖符号搜索
papers.tldr: 公式化Alpha发现是依赖池的符号搜索，反馈只在完整表达式被评估时出现，因此监督信号延迟且稀疏。AlphaRJM提出Reward-Jump Memory，在token构建过程中保持事件驱动隐状态不变，仅在终端评估事件用已实现池奖励与结果更新；并用动作条件SDE回报评论器，以随机粒子表示未来折扣发现回报。该设计在多个股票池、预测周期和随机种子下取得强而稳定的增益，消融实验验证持久评估历史、随机回报建模与分布监督的互补作用。
papers.abstract_en: Formulaic alpha discovery is a pool-dependent symbolic search problem in which informative feedback is observed primarily when a complete expression is evaluated. This delayed feedback creates two coupled difficulties: the retained alpha pool does not preserve the full history of realized evaluation feedback, and the value of an intermediate construction action is uncertain because its consequence depends on the formula eventually completed. We introduce AlphaRJM, which addresses these difficulties through Reward-Jump Memory, an event-driven latent state that remains fixed during token construction and updates only at terminal evaluation events using the realized pool reward and evaluation outcome, and an action-conditioned SDE return critic that represents future discounted discovery returns with stochastic particles. The particles guide action selection through their mean and uncertainty and are learned using a distributional Bellman objective combining energy-distance matching, mean calibration, and jump regularization. Empirically, AlphaRJM delivers strong and stable gains across multiple equity universes, forecasting horizons, and random seeds, while ablations confirm the complementary roles of persistent evaluation history, stochastic return modeling, and distributional supervision.
